title: AI support drafts and a knowledge base that trains new VAs
systemName: Your support knowledge base and email drafting

facts: Upwork post 2026-10-26: AI Automation Engineer for Support, Knowledge Base and Workflow Automation. Online brand selling configurable technical products; wants faster email answers, one AI knowledge base of product knowledge and policies, and VA training material from it. Uses an unnamed helpdesk, open to change. Names OpenAI and Claude.
No contact name in the post; recipient falls back to your team (U-006).
Product line, customer, articles and VA are invented sample data.

thread.subject: Two PX-48s on one inverter?
thread.label: Support
thread.body: Hi, I already have one {{product.name}} on my {{product.inverter}}. Can I add a second one to get more run time? And would that void the warranty? Thanks, {{customer.first}}

draft.body: Hi {{customer.first}}, yes, you can run two {{product.name}} units on your {{product.inverter}}. Connect them in parallel with the {{product.kit}} so they charge and drain evenly. Your warranty stays valid as long as the kit is used for the connection. Setup steps are in {{kb.article}}, and the warranty terms are in {{kb.policy}}. Let me know if you'd like the step by step guide sent over.

statuses: Customer email in the support inbox
